messages:
carter: Heads-up — I'm planning a canary for r1028 to EU-west. Want to do a staggered traffic ramp with smoothing to avoid tripping the guard if a single step slips.
nikki: Good call. Last time a 5% -> 50% step caused the circuit to flip for 3m and rolled back. We should smooth over multiple steps.
carter: Proposed plan: 2% -> 8% -> 20% -> 50% over 25m total, 5m steady between steps. Add a smoothing policy that enforces max change-per-minute = 5%.
maya: @deploy-bot can you open a change window for 2026-03-25T23:00Z and attach manual-approval path? We need a quick manual override if latency spikes.
deploy-bot: change-window request received: start=2026-03-25T23:00Z duration=60m owners=eng-releases. Awaiting approvals.
sanjay: Also please enforce a guard threshold: if p95 latency > 800ms or error-rate > 0.6% during any step, auto-hold and notify oncall.
carter: Adding that. Snippet for rollout config:
```
rollout:
  strategy: canary
  steps:
    - weight: 2
      duration: 300s
    - weight: 8
      duration: 300s
    - weight: 20
      duration: 600s
    - weight: 50
      duration: 600s
  smoothing:
    max_delta_per_min: 5
  guards:
    - name: latency-p95
      threshold_ms: 800
    - name: error-rate
      threshold_pct: 0.6
  on_guard_trip: hold_and_notify
```
nikki: Should we cap individual step delta to 15% as a safety net? Also consider a soft-fallback path to the previous model variant instead of full rollback.
maya: Yes to both. Add fallback: model_variant: r1027 for warm standby and a fast switch policy.
carter: One more: deploy-bot timeout for approval needs to be longer than default, maybe 30m, so we don't accidentally auto-approve during the middle of the ramp.
deploy-bot: noted — requested approval timeout set to 30m. Ping @eng-releases when you approve so the bot proceeds. :thumbsup:
nikki: Approving now. I'll watch metrics for first two steps and stand by for manual hold.
maya: Approved. I'll be oncall for the last 30m of the window.
carter: Thanks — proceeding to finalize config and upload to release-orchestra. Will post a link once it's in.
deploy-bot: deploy config uploaded: https://internal/release-orchestra/r1028-canary. Reminder: manual approval required to start.
